name: Grand Theft Auto V
policy_notice: Rockstar integrated BattlEye into GTA V in September 2024. Story Mode is 100% playable by passing '-nobattleye'. Official GTA Online multiplayer servers require the BattlEye kernel driver and are blocked under Wine.
sources: Rockstar Support Bulletin: BattlEye Integration in Grand Theft Auto V (September 2024)
